lines.beaver: 얼굴이 복잡해 보이네. 무슨 일 있어?
lines.beaver_en: You look troubled. What's going on?
lines.beaver_roman: eolguri bokjapae boine. museun il isseo?
lines.learner: 어제 회사 그만뒀어. 후련한데 좀 분하기도 해.
lines.en: I quit my job yesterday. I feel relieved, but also bitter.
lines.roman: eoje hoesa geumandwosseo. huryeonhande jom bunhagido hae.

lines.learner: 마지막 날 부장님이 사람들 앞에서 크게 화내셨어.
lines.en: On my last day, my manager got really angry in front of everyone.
lines.roman: majimang nal bujangnimi saramdeul apeseo keuge hwanaesyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, you must have been so hurt.
lines.learner: 다들 보는 앞이라 너무 비참하고 처량했어.
lines.en: Everyone was watching, so I felt miserable and forlorn.
lines.roman: dadeul boneun apira neomu bichamhago cheoryanghaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: You must have cried a lot. Are you okay?
lines.learner: 집에 와서 엉엉 울었어. 내가 너무 불쌍하더라.
lines.en: I sobbed when I got home. I felt so sorry for myself.
lines.roman: jibe waseo eongeong ureosseo. naega neomu bulssanghadeora.

lines.beaver: 그래도 이제 다 끝났잖아. 아쉬움이 남아?
lines.beaver_en: Still, it's all over now. Any regrets?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraedo ije da kkeunnatjana. aswiumi nama?
lines.learner: 아니, 그 생각만 하면 지금도 화가 나.
lines.en: No, just thinking about it still makes me angry.
lines.roman: ani, geu saenggangman hamyeon jigeumdo hwaga na.

lines.beaver: 미련은 없다니 다행이다. 요즘은 뭐 해?
lines.beaver_en: Glad you have no regrets. What are you doing these days?
lines.beaver_roman: miryeoneun eopdani dahaengida. yojeumeun mwo hae?
lines.learner: 할 일이 없어서 하루 종일 무료해.
lines.en: I have nothing to do, so I'm bored all day.
lines.roman: hal iri eopseoseo haru jongil muryohae.

lines.beaver_en: Still, how are you feeling lately?
lines.learner: 이상하게 새 출발 생각에 들뜨기도 해.
lines.en: Strangely, I'm also excited about a fresh start.
lines.roman: isanghage sae chulbal saenggage deultteugido hae.

lines.beaver_en: That's a good sign. Do you have a next plan?
lines.learner: 그동안 일한 경험을 바탕으로 가게를 열 거야.
lines.en: I'm going to open a shop based on my work experience.
lines.roman: geudongan ilhan gyeongheomeul batangeuro gagereul yeol kkeoya.

lines.beaver: 와, 멋지다! 너라면 정말 잘할 거야.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's great! You'll do really well.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, meotjida! neoramyeon jeongmal jalhal kkeoya.
lines.learner: 그 말 들으니까 눈물 날 것 같아.
lines.en: Hearing that makes me want to cry.
lines.roman: geu mal deureunikka nunmul nal kkeot gata.

lines.beaver: 울지 마. 언제든 연락해. 늘 네 편이야.
lines.beaver_en: Don't cry. Call me anytime. I'm always on your side.
lines.beaver_roman: ulji ma. eonjedeun yeollakae. neul ne pyeoniya.
lines.learner: 너 같은 친구가 있어서 천만다행이야. 고마워.
lines.en: I'm so lucky to have a friend like you. Thanks.
lines.roman: neo gateun chinguga isseoseo cheonmandahaengiya. gomawo.
